Name: Magical Lamp Posts
Author: NasikaSakura
Description:
[b]Disclosure: [/b]
Full disclosure, I am really not a modder. I am an avid Stardew Valley skins mod consumer. I really wanted specific assets from this collection to combine with other mods and saw from the page's feedback that other people were wanting that too. Since it's been a year since the mod has last been updated, I figure I'd make my own solution and upload it here, with full credit, for anyone else wanting to use it! :) Feel free to replicate what I did to isolate the other assets if you like, and please check out the original creators' work! They're really something, and I personally use pieces of all three mods bellow, and then some! 

[b]Credit: [/b]
Assets isolated by NasikaSakura. Assets from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3952]"Overgrown Fairy Craftables" version 1.2 created by Nexus user Linbun[/url], to complement [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/494]"Ali's Overgrown Fairy Buildings" version 1 created by Nexus user Ali Read[/url].  Code adjusted from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3499]"Cute Valley - Pink" version 1.5.2 created by Nexus user Rosalie[/url]. [b] [/b]
[b]
Method:[/b] 
I dissected the code for "Cute Valley - Pink" mod by Rosalie since she isolated each asset as its own png image and used a "true" and "false" configuration in her content JSON file to turn them on and off. I used this as a template, deleting everything that didn't involve the wooden and iron lamp posts, and replaced the corresponding png files with the magical lamp posts pngs, expanded on next. 

For the image files, I opened Linbun's craftables png file and the Rosalie's wood and iron lamp post pngs in Microsoft Paint, since MS Paint is a freeware automatically installed on Windows machines. In MS Paint, I copied the magical lamp posts and pasted them into the Cute Valley lamp post file, overlapping perfectly (turn on Transparent Selection from the Selection drop-down menu to help make this easier as it will turn your right-click color into transparency when pasting new content), erased what wasn't necessary, and filled the background that I wanted to make transparent with an unused color. Saved as a png. Then, I uploaded the file to OnlinePNGTools, selected the background color, changed "Match similar color tones" and "Edge smooth radius" to 0, and downloaded the new files. Lastly, I changed the file names to match what was referenced in the JSON files and placed them into my new mod folder. 
https://onlinepngtools.com/create-transparent-png 

After all files had been adjusted and placed into the Smapi mods folder, I ran Stardew Valley to ensure my makeshift mod worked, and it did! I hope it does for you too. :3
